name: Popular Octopus 83
author: portseif
description: Outlined white button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from transparent to #fff, width becomes 3rem.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Popular Octopus 83</title>
<style>
/* Popular Octopus 83 by portseif — https://uiverse.io/portseif/popular-octopus-83 */
button {
  align-items: center;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  font-family: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,system-ui,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"Noto Sans",sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji";
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-decoration: none;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  outline: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 1rem;
}

button:before {
  background-color: #fff;
  content: "";
  display: inline-block;
  height: 1px;
  margin-right: 10px;
  transition: all .42s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1);
  width: 0;
}

button:hover:before {
  background-color: #fff;
  width: 3rem;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
